notes.title: Early Access Update - v0.47
notes.notes:
The Emperor and State has now been updated to version 0.47. If you encounter any bugs or issues in the game, please use the in-game feedback feature or discuss them on our [url=https://discord.gg/4VHjVCz9qu]Discord[/url].

[h2]New Content[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added the feature to upgrade roads. Counties upgraded to official roads will have -1 mobility consumption.
[/list]

[h2]Improving[/h2]
[list]
[*] Slightly reduced the probability of officials proposing target tasks during morning court sessions.
[*] Added functionality to display road levels in each province on the macro map view.
[*] Slightly increased the effect of the national building "Ding" in boosting governance (effective upon reconstruction).
[*] Adjusted cultural zone boundaries, expanding the territory of the Maritime Cultural Zone.
[*] When relocating the capital, 10% of the capital's grain reserves will be transferred to the new capital without any loss, while the remaining 90% will be sent to the nearest granary with the lowest loss.
[*] Increased the cost of relocating the capital; the cost now also depends on the distance to the new capital.
[*] Various other minor optimizations and adjustments.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where expired targets could still be completed after failing.
[*] Fixed an issue where province names might display incorrectly on the macro map under certain conditions.
[*] Fixed a bug where the grain reserve popup in the map scene could display incorrectly in some cases.
[*] Fixed a bug where downgrading buildings via delegation would incur additional unintended costs.
[*] Fixed various other minor bugs.
[/list]

notes.title: Early Access Update - v0.46
notes.notes:
The Emperor and State has now been updated to version 0.46. If you encounter any bugs or issues in the game, please use the in-game feedback feature or discuss them on our [url=https://discord.gg/4VHjVCz9qu]Discord[/url].

[h2]Improving[/h2]
[list]
[*] Replaced the old granary efficiency system with an all-new Grain Reserve system:
 1. Percentages have been replaced with specific numerical values;
 2. The Ministry of Revenue now includes [Grain Allocation] and [Tax Grain Settings] functions;
 3. Land tax has been separated from industry tax — it now affects public support and poverty rates, while industry tax no longer affects public support;
 4. Military expeditions are now constrained by supply lines.
[*] Improved power consumption calculations on the strategic map to reduce lag in the late game when the map becomes large.
[*] Improved the childhood portraits UI for imperial princes.
[*] Various minor UI and system refinements.
[/list]
*As this update involves many systems, some minor oversights may remain — we'll continue refining things in the coming days.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed several minor bugs.
[/list]

notes.title: Early Access Update - v0.35
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! The 0.35 version of The Emperor and State is now live. In this patch, the Steam Workshop has officially been launched, and the beginner's guide has been further improved. Additionally, the game is currently on sale at a 15% discount. The discount will last until October 7th, so interested players, don’t miss out. Below are the detailed update notes:

[h2]Steam Workshop[/h2]  
[list]  
[*] Famous Officers Data Editing: Players can modify various stats of famous officers according to their preferences and share them on the Steam Workshop, as well as apply them in their own games.  
[*] Concubine Portrait Replacement: Players can replace all concubine portraits in the game.  
[/list]  
Both features can currently be edited via the in-game modding tools. You can also download mods shared by other players in the Workshop. More Workshop features will be unlocked in the future, and if there are any features you would like to see, feel free to comment and leave suggestions.

[h2]Beginner's Guide[/h2]  
[list]  
[*] We have made the opening introduction more detailed, recreating the final six months of the first emperor’s reign to help the next ruler (the player) become familiar with the court and harem features. (Uncheck the beginner's guide option at the start to skip this part.)  
[/list]  

[h2]Objectives System[/h2]  
[list]  
[*] The initial version of the "Recent Objectives" system has been implemented, but further optimization is still required.  
[/list]  

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]  
[list]  
[*] Fixed a bug that could cause errors during position adjustments.  
[*] Fixed a bug where a national building construction task might disappear without reason, leaving the building permanently under construction.  
[/list]  

[h2]Improvings[/h2]  
[list]  
[*] Adjusted the algorithm to restrict AI forces to only deploy troops from the capital.  
[*] Corrected some text display issues where characters were garbled.  
[*] Various other small Improvings.  
[/list] 

If you encounter any bugs or issues in the game, please use the in-game feedback feature or discuss them on our [url=https://discord.gg/4VHjVCz9qu]Discord[/url].

notes.title: Demo Update-v0.298
notes.notes:
[h3]English localization is still in progress, and currently, the demo does not support English. We sincerely ask for your understanding and patience.[/h3]

[h2]Patch Notes 0.298[/h2]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the initial emperor's attribute points for intelligence were displayed incorrectly.
[*] Fixed a bug where pressing the space bar rapidly when the Long Live panel appeared would cause a significant drop in stamina and mood.
[*] Fixed a bug where the displayed combat power when creating a new army did not match the combat power shown in the minister's introduction.
[*] Fixed a bug caused by a logical error after the capital was occupied, error code: D43Q.
[*] Fixed an error in the interpretation of public opinion in the public opinion popup.
[*] Fixed a bug where the content in the harem tranquility popup was parsed incorrectly.
[*] Fixed a bug where the diplomacy table could not be sorted.
[*] Fixed a bug where the nameplate of officials was displayed incorrectly when constructing national buildings in certain circumstances.
[*] Fixed two errors in local construction assignments in the Ministry of Works and optimized multiple text descriptions.
[*] Fixed a bug where the harem tranquility data did not refresh in time after concubines were sent to the cold palace.
[*] Fixed a bug where the symbol of Wei Prefecture was displayed in Xiang Prefecture.
[*] Fixed a bug where the bonuses shown during the selection of candidates in the Yan Ying Hall did not match the bonuses shown after the candidates were confirmed.
[*] Fixed a bug where, during an attack by the player, the morale reduction for both sides was counted twice, amplifying the advantage for the side with higher morale.
[*] Fixed a bug where the policy case could not be issued due to a zero-quality policy.
[*] Fixed multiple text errors.
[*] Fixed multiple minor bugs.
[/list]

[h2]Improving[/h2]
[list]
[*] Reduced the maintenance costs for morale and armament.
[*] Coastal prefectures are no longer considered borderlands when the Ministry of Works assigns construction projects.
[*] When AI forces are reduced to only one state, the extra morale boost in battles is reduced from 25% of national consciousness to 16%.
[*] If no notable officials appear after three recruitment edicts, a notable official is guaranteed to appear on the list after the third edict.
[*] Optimized the combat algorithm, reducing the probability of the side with a less capable commander gaining the upper hand.
[*] Increased the influence of concubines on imperial prestige based on their rank (purple, red, orange).
[*] Slightly reduced battle difficulty.
[/list]

[h2]New Content[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a new orange rank for contemporary concubines, in addition to the historical concubines of purple and red ranks.
[*] If no notable officials appear in one examination, the probability of notable officials appearing in the next examination is slightly increased (approximately by literacy rate +1), which accumulates until a notable official appears. This bonus resets and accumulates again after a notable official appears. (This applies to both proactive examinations and annual autumn trials.)
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Update-v0.297
notes.notes:
[h3]English localization is still in progress, and currently, the demo does not support English. We sincerely ask for your understanding and patience.[/h3]

[h3]Patch Notes 0.297[/h3]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed several text display errors.
[*] Fixed a bug that could cause officials to duplicate.
[*] Fixed a bug where nameplates displayed garbled characters when repairing palace buildings.
[*] Fixed inaccurate introduction information in the pop-up window for provincial governance.
[*] Fixed a bug where the stamina bar display was inaccurate in certain map modes.
[*] Fixed incorrect display of wood description in the item table.
[*] Fixed a bug where battle reports sometimes showed zero enemies killed despite annihilating the enemy army.
[*] Fixed a bug where a state would still belong to a specific province after the capital was moved.
[*] Fixed a bug where generals could return to the capital and be dispatched again while leading an expedition.
[*] And some other minor bug fixes.
[/list]


[h2]Optimizations[/h2]
[list]
[*] Optimized the algorithm for civil service exam candidates’ performance, making it less dependent on personal abilities. This reduces the difference in performance attributes between early and later stages of the game.
[*] The progress of the capital relocation task will pause if the destination is no longer under the nation’s control.
[*] Optimized the algorithm for setting provincial jurisdictions to avoid potential bugs.
[*] Officials can now be directly appointed or reassigned at any time through the Ministry of Personnel's [Position Adjustment] function.
[*] A pop-up reminder of the importance of establishing a provincial capital will appear if it has not been set after editing the provincial jurisdiction.
[*] Adjusted the warehouse fill rate algorithm to speed up its convergence to the target value.
[*] Overall development speed of AI forces has been reduced.
[*] Ministers can now be given medicine without task or regional restrictions; all listed individuals can receive it.
[*] And some other minor optimizations.
[/list]


[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added right-click cancel functionality and three dedicated shortcut keys. (See [Shortcut Key Description] in the top right settings for details)
[/list]

notes.title: The Emperor and State - Early Access Version is Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Thank you for your support for The Emperor and State. The game is still in development, and if everything goes smoothly, the 0.3 Early Access version will be launched around the end of April or early May 2024. Apart from continuously improving the game content, we need your input on the wishlist for the main game. If the quantity is sufficient and the game development proceeds smoothly, the EA plan can be realized as intended.

↓↓↓Please add our game to your wishlist! Your support is our best power.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2716930

If there are any changes to the launch time, we will inform you in advance. If the launch does not go as planned in May, a limited-time playtest/demo of the new version will also be available, so please stay tuned.

The 0.3 Early Access version is just the beginning, and there is still a long way to go before the official 1.0 version. Despite the challenges ahead, we are committed to not betraying the initial intention and making the game progressively better.
